description: Arps cumulative (qi = 1000, Di = 0.1/month, b = 1.0) against adaptive numerical quadrature of the textbook rate form q = qi(1+bDit)^(-1/b).
tolerance_justification: quad requested to 1e-12 abs / 1e-13 rel; cumulatives are O(1e4), so float64 evaluation error is ~1e-12 relative. 1e-11 rel is ~10x.
